name: Watcher Corrin's Journal
description: A derelict watchtower stands on the Dead Road. An old Lightkeeper named Watcher Corrin spent years there recording the retreat of the light — his journal may still be inside.

investigate_watchtower.label: Investigate the Old Watchtower
investigate_watchtower.description: A silhouette of a derelict watchtower is visible to the east of the Dead Road. Investigate it — someone may have left records inside.

completionActions.text: The scope still works. Lighthouse Mara is flickering — and there may be a journal left behind in this tower.

find_journal.label: Find Watcher Corrin's Journal
find_journal.description: Watcher Corrin documented the retreat of the light year by year. His observation journal should be in the inner room of the watchtower.

completionActions.text: You found Corrin's journal. The Old Keeper in the crypts served on the perimeter — he would recognize this.

return_to_keeper.label: Return the Journal to the Old Keeper
return_to_keeper.description: The Old Keeper knew Watcher Corrin. Bring him the journal — he deserves to read it.

completionActions.text: Quest complete: Watcher Corrin's Journal. The Old Keeper finally knows what happened to his friend.
